about: Bills coded to the alignment questions (public/questions.json): {question id: {bill id (congress-type-number, as in the bill index): [side index, why]}}. A bill is coded only when it is clearly on one side of the question; procedural measures (rules for considering a bill), budget resolutions, large packages where the question is one provision among many (a tax law counts on the tax questions when tax changes are its main purpose, as with the 2017 and 2025 tax laws), and bills that apply to a single territory are left out. Each was read from its titles and the Congressional Research Service's summary (scripts/question-bills.mjs lists the candidates).
